user.title: Guest Mode Setup
user.description: Add at least one zone, optionally set up WiFi, then finish.

add_zone.title: Add Zone
add_zone.description: Create a new guest mode zone. Use the search field to find entities by name or entity ID.

data_description.auto_off_hours: Turn this zone off automatically after this many hours and restore the previous states. 0 disables the timer.

wifi.title: WiFi Configuration
